title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, an unauthenticated user could trick a user…
description: Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 contain a vulnerability where an unauthenticated attacker can trick an active Splunk Web user into running arbitrary SPL searches via a crafted link. This can potentially expose stored credentials and indexed data. Exploitation requires phishing the user to open the malicious link. The vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of user-controlled data when generating SPL searches for field reports.
